mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% signals accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS below 0.5% but 20-day forward returns negative in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate falling below 7.0% for two consecutive months signals tightening labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE below 7.0% for two months but 5-day forward returns negative in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) above 3-month moving averages indicates strong consumer demand that accelerates corporate revenue growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: Both HOUST and RSAFS above 3-month MA but 20-day forward returns negative in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL year-over-year change exceeding 3.0%) trigger Federal Reserve tightening that increases equity discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL YoY change > 3.0% but 60-day forward returns positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 12-month moving average indicates strengthening labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS above 12-month MA but 20-day forward returns negative in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) declining below 6-month moving average for three consecutive months signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO below 6mo MA for 3 months but 5-day forward returns positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in real GDP growth (GDPC1) below 0.5% annualized and housing starts (HOUST) below 800 thousand indicates economic weakening that increases recession risk, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: Both GDPC1 < 0.5% annualized and HOUST < 800 but 60-day forward returns positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Strong industrial production growth (INDPRO exceeding 1.5% monthly) signals manufacturing expansion that boosts corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO > 1.5% monthly but 20-day forward returns negative in more than 60% of cases.
